conditional.interpretation: Fixed separate-versus-joint development allocation screen; not a significance or noninferiority test. No ablation may replace the primary candidate.

conditional.interpretation: Separate-versus-fixed-random-visual-features attribution screen; passing cannot rescue a failed primary outcome screen.

inference: Six independent seeds per architecture. Curves/supports/actions/horizons are not replicates. 20,000 paired seed bootstrap resamples, RNG 27192026; intervals are descriptive. Held-out post-update AUC and performed-action prequential error are distinct outcomes.

record_integrity.scope: Source/analysis/config/protocol locks, complete phase/hash/state-chain metadata and raw numerical arithmetic; no pickle loading or ordinary retraining.
